text:
devin: quick idea — add a "grace toggle" in rollout controls: pick 0-30s to keep preferring primary before switching. pros/cons?

maria: yes. call out whether it counts against client timeout. separate toggle for latency vs error triggers.

sam: default 5s. add tooltip: 'prefer primary for this duration; may increase p95'. console should have a "simulate spike" preview.

devin: thinking of simple degrade modes: keep_trying, partial_return, failfast. want names to be clear in runbooks.

olivia: runbook-friendly names are good. also add a small "why" pill in the request list that explains fallback reason with a link to trace.

ops-bot: feature-flag: grace_toggle_rollout=20%

maria: telemetry reqs: record trigger_reason, final_mode, latency_ms_at_trigger, tokens_primary, tokens_fallback, sampled_trace_id. sampling per-org.

sam: audit: retain sampled raw outputs 90d default; UI replay + side-by-side diff; gate raw outputs by RBAC and require SSO to view.

devin: API change: emit header X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=keep_trying;trigger=latency;trace=tr_abc when fallback happens. also optional fallback_meta in body when ?debug=true and authorized.

sam: example curl to check header:

  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# response header: X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=partial_return;trigger=error_rate;trace=abc123

maria: default sampling suggestion: 0.1% org-wide; bump to 5% for experiment cohorts.

ops-bot: sampling_rate=0.1% / experiment=5% (tag: grace_toggle_expt)

olivia: UX: pill should show short reason + CTA "compare with primary" to open diff viewer. also add an operator-only "force-failfast" toggle for emergencies (audited).

maria: action items: 1) telemetry schema PR 2) API header + fallback_meta spec 3) console pill + compare flow 4) RBAC + audit for raw outputs 5) experiment rollout plan 6) runbook copy

devin: i'll sketch UI mock and open GH issues for the action items. thanks all.
